Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we can align on next steps:

- Primary use case: embed real-time assistant into customer support workflows to reduce resolution time and extract structured case summaries.
- Key constraints: PII handling, on-prem requirement for audit logs, target SLA p95 latency <200ms for short responses.
- Current trial metrics: ~1k daily requests, spike to 3k during business hours.

Next steps
1) Technical deep dive / demo with SE to validate integration and latency profile
2) Review security/compliance artifacts (SOC 2 evidence, data flow diagram)
3) Procurement info (T&Cs, pricing range)

Proposed times for a 60-min technical demo (all times PT):
- Tue Apr 19, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
